title: Self-referential universal property of the upper-triangular gluing as a lax limit of stable infinity-categories
author: Gustavo Jasso
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the article's Proposition 2.9.7 (source label 'prop:lax-limit'), the self-referential universal property of the upper-triangular gluing: for an exact functor between stable infinity-categories, the exact functor category into the gluing is canonically equivalent to the pullback of the two exact functor categories along the post-composition functor, with the equivalence exhibited explicitly by the pair formed by the projection and the counit of the adjunction. The unit is above ordinary PhD qualifying level because the counted proof is not a formal triviality: it uses the cartesian square induced by the gluing to produce the comparison functor, identifies the two composites with the projections of the pullback through the universal property of the lax limit, and verifies that the comparison is an equivalence of stable infinity-categories rather than merely of their homotopy categories, which requires the exactness of the functors involved. Establishing a universal property of a lax limit inside the theory of stable infinity-categories is research-level higher category theory and homological algebra, beyond ordinary PhD qualifying examinations.
